questions.question: Explain what makes a shape a polygon and name the polygons with 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 sides.
questions.expected_answer: A polygon is a flat, closed shape made only of straight sides joined at corners. Three sides is a triangle, four a quadrilateral, five a pentagon, six a hexagon, seven a heptagon and eight an octagon.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a regular and an irregular polygon, using a square and a rectangle as examples.
questions.expected_answer: A regular polygon has all sides equal and all corners equal; a square is regular. An irregular polygon has some sides or corners different; a rectangle that is not a square has equal corners but two longer and two shorter sides, so it is irregular. Both are quadrilaterals.

questions.question: Describe a stop sign, a classroom door and a clock face fully, naming each shape, saying whether it is regular, and giving the number of sides and corners.
questions.expected_answer: Stop sign: a regular octagon with 8 sides and 8 corners. Door: an irregular quadrilateral, a rectangle, with 4 sides and 4 corners. Clock face: a circle, which is not a polygon, with 1 curved side and no corners.
